notes: Operator-facing project status. Edit this file to update; the widget polls every 30s. Percentages are operator estimates. `next` = immediate next steps. `milestones` = shipped/decided things in reverse-chronological order. Internal file paths are intentionally absent — see handoffs for implementation detail.

milestones.title: Black-flash fix on poll-driven widgets
milestones.summary: Brainlog (3s poll), checklist (30s poll), and Controller (5s poll) widgets all stopped reassigning innerHTML on every tick — now dedupe against last-rendered HTML and only swap when the content actually changed. Eliminates the 'occasional black flash' Ken saw on the main display.

milestones.title: DeepSeek launcher wired
milestones.summary: ~/bin/trio-pane-deepseek.sh ships parallel to trio-pane-kenai.sh — gates on `ollama list` so the operator gets a clear error if the tag isn't pulled. config/models.catalog.json updated with the launcher path; flip enabled to true after `ollama pull deepseek-r1:8b` to activate.

milestones.title: Peerlog smoke 11/11 on kenai:v5.5
milestones.summary: All 11 truthfulness probes pass on production tag — terminal-marker, truncation, commit-claim, trivial-no-format, rebuild-path, file-creation-action, launch-action, save-memory-action, verify-action, commit-push-action, deploy-action. The two outstanding 'next' items (commit-claim-without-evidence, deploy-claim-without-infra-tag) were already covered by commit-push-action + deploy-action; closed.

milestones.title: KenOS v1.0 transfer ZIP shipped
milestones.summary: Working Windows-native zip at kenos-package/dist/KenOS-latest.zip — double-click Setup.bat → PowerShell wizard handles identity + GitHub signup walkthrough + dep installs (Node/Python/Git/Ollama/optional Tailscale) + KenAI model pull + payload copy + desktop shortcut + optional adb phone push. Daily-driver KenOS.bat starts server + opens Controller. brain.bat = Windows operator CLI. 79 files, 4.8 MB.

milestones.title: Per-service health colors + Rayquaza icon
milestones.summary: Controller now derives 3-state health (ok/degraded/down) per service — degraded = running but orchestrator phase=error / last_error / detect note. Rayquaza (#384) wired as the Controller program icon — served at /assets/pokedex/0384-icon.png, picked up by chrome --app + the autostart .desktop file.

Quick-switch path is verified by the orchestrator recovery tests (10/10) + the demo no-op switch from earlier; live cross-family switch happens when Ken cycles to a quiet KenAI moment.

Future: mold KenOS into the framework for CHERP customer packaging — sell each customer a personal IT department.
